entry_contract.h1_trend: LONG when H1 EMA50 > EMA200 and EMA200 is rising; SHORT when EMA50 < EMA200 and EMA200 is falling
entry_contract.close_location: LONG close in top 15 percent of M15 range; SHORT close in bottom 15 percent
entry_contract.m15_ema20: LONG close above EMA20; SHORT close below EMA20
entry_contract.episode_rule: consecutive same-direction impulse candles are one episode; only the first is eligible
entry_contract.entry: after the M15 signal closes, enter at the exact next M5 open

risk_and_exit_contract.stop: LONG below signal-bar low by 0.1*M15 ATR14; SHORT above signal-bar high by 0.1*M15 ATR14

refined_successor.purpose: reduce loss count and raise win rate without using post-2026 outcomes

risk_cap_comparison_note: The uncapped impulse setup was the only broad multi-vector survivor. Risk caps 75/100/125/150 pips all remained positive in discovery and validation; 100 pips is retained as the common maximum-risk contract, not a confirmed optimum.
